verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official MCP server documented at attio.com/mcp. First-party docs also say users can connect Claude, ChatGPT or another AI tool to search, update and manage their Attio workspace, which covers the core of connecting an agent through an official MCP server. Missing for 10: detailed docs on setup, authentication and the exposed tool set, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work reliably.
